summary: Drop-in mover over the steering behaviours, including flocking.
overview: Pick a mode, assign a target where one is needed, and it handles velocity integration and facing. It moves the transform directly with no Rigidbody, matching the kinematic style the rest of the toolkit uses.
useCases: A flock of birds or a school of fish.
Pursuit that curves naturally rather than turning on the spot.

params.tuning: The turn-rate control. Lower makes wider, more graceful arcs; higher makes sharp, insect-like turns.
Required for Seek, Flee and Arrive, ignored by Wander. Unassigned in a seek mode, the agent simply sits still.
Flocking looks for other agents within this radius every update, so a large radius in a big flock is the expensive part.
Of the three flocking weights, this is the one that stops the flock collapsing into one point. Raise it first if they clump.

gotchas.title: No collision avoidance
gotchas.body: Steering is about direction, not obstacles. Flocks fly through walls unless you add avoidance yourself.

gotchas.title: Flocking cost grows with flock size
gotchas.body: Each agent looks for neighbours, so cost rises faster than linearly. Keep the radius tight for large flocks.
